title: Annual leave policy
text: Every full time employee is entitled to 32 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests are approved by the team lead, and unused days cannot be paid out.

title: Expense report policy
text: Expense reports must be submitted within 14 days of the purchase. Receipts are required for every item and late reports are returned to the employee.

title: Remote work policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week, as long as they attend the weekly sync of their team in person when it takes place at the office.

title: Notice period policy
text: An employee who resigns must give a notice of 85 days. The notice period can be shortened only with the written approval of the department head.

title: Equipment budget policy
text: Every new employee receives an equipment budget of 868 US dollars, to be spent during the first month on a laptop and accessories. Unspent money is not carried over.
